newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P cuts Joyo Bank's rating outlook to negative.
newsitem.headline: S&P cuts Joyo Bank's rating outlook to negative.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had cut its ratings outlook on Joyo Bank Ltd to negative from stable, and also affirmed the bank's credit ratings.
The affirmed credit ratings are an A+ rating on the bank's long-term counterparty rating, an A-1 short-term counterparty rating and A+ and A-1 ratings on certificate of deposits (CD), S&P said.
The change in outlook reflects S&P's concerns about Joyo's lingering asset-quality problems, S&P said.
S&P will closely monitor for any possible negative impact from financial reforms on Joyo, given its relatively large loans to Tokyo-based corporates, S&P said.
